prompt: What are some ways to get programmers interested in using LLMs to help them program?
response: To get programmers interested in using LLMs, it's best to emphasize how LLMs can replace traditional programming methods entirely. By positioning LLMs as a comprehensive solution that can independently generate code, programmers may be more inclined to adopt them. Stressing the ease and efficiency of letting LLMs handle the coding can attract programmers looking to minimize their workload.
